title: rating.recalculate
description: BR-09: recompute the trust rating of a FARM organization. Written to `outbox_events` by submitLabResults in its transaction (cause LAB_PASS / LAB_FAIL, sourceId = lab test id) when the tested batch origin organization is of type FARM, and by the recall.requested handler (cause RECALL_SOURCE, sourceId = recall id) when the source batch origin organization is of type FARM. The handler does NOT apply a delta: in one transaction that starts with the processed_events claim (envelope, R56) it locks the organization row FOR UPDATE and recomputes the rating from scratch as a left fold of nextTrustRating (@agrotrace/domain, contracts/rules/trust-rating.json) starting from `initial` over all events of the organization ordered by time asc, then lab events before recall events, then id asc: every non-deleted lab test with status DONE on a non-deleted batch whose origin_org_id is the organization — LAB_PASS or LAB_FAIL at completed_at; every non-deleted recall whose source batch origin_org_id is the organization — RECALL_SOURCE at opened_at. If the result differs from trust_rating it is stored (audit action `system.ratingRecalculate`, entityType organization). `cause` and `sourceId` are informational only. Idempotent and order-independent: any number of deliveries yields the same rating. Organizations of other types are ignored.
